light_description: South Korean handmade distortion centered on 1980s-style gain, with wide-range tone shaping and a two-position clipping/voice switch.
South Korean Range84 variant with a more vintage-oriented voice and smoother texture, documented as a distinct production state.
Later South Korean distortion in the Range family, combining 1980s gain references with a broader boutique voicing.
South Korean handmade overdrive using the BJPress wide-range analog voicing concept and color control.
Later BJPress overdrive state documented in Korean dealer catalog records as a named revision of the Blue Tonic line.
South Korean handmade overdrive in the BJPress catalog, preserved as a separate named product from Blue Tonic.
